config_hash_definition: sha256 over json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8') of the 'config' object in this file

config.purpose: PA-only baseline-reproduction run: P0_log5, P1_B_logreg, P1_H3_incumbent_refit on the four registered folds

inputs.features_supersedence_note: The canonical 8-feature H3 set (incl. ew_pitcher/ew_batter, EW-90d) lives only in overnight-p2\data\features_v3.parquet, which SUPERSEDES the p1-harness-v2 features frame for this run.

superseded_default_features.note: p1-harness-v2 default features frame (731,347 x 21) lacks ew_pitcher/ew_batter and cannot serve the H3 candidate; documented as superseded, not used.

P0_log5.definition: full log5 identity on w150 priors + lg_rate; closed-form, no fit, no scaler
P0_log5.calibration: no calibrator; outputs RAW lane only (pred_raw)

P1_B_logreg.definition: LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=1000) on the 6 frozen B features
P1_B_logreg.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on base_train ONLY, one scaler per fold (no eval/cal rows touch the scaler)
P1_B_logreg.calibration: block sigmoid (1-D unpenalized logistic of y on logit(p)) fit on the calibration sub-block ONLY - the 60 calendar days bearing PAs [cal_first..cal_last] per fold, derived at runtime (cal_last = max game_date <= train_end; cal_first = cal_last - 59 days). RAW and CAL lanes BOTH output, BOTH labeled (pred_raw / pred_cal), BOTH reported.

P1_H3_incumbent_refit.h3_label: incumbent-procedure refit - re-executes the frozen H3 fitting procedure on the registered folds; NOT proven prediction-equivalent to historical incumbent outputs (pred_H3_raw); equivalence requires a separate real-data comparison requiring authorization
P1_H3_incumbent_refit.definition: same logistic spec as P1_B_logreg on the 8 H3 features; formerly registered as P1_H3_replay (superseded ID)
P1_H3_incumbent_refit.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on base_train ONLY, one scaler per fold (no eval/cal rows touch the scaler)
P1_H3_incumbent_refit.calibration: block sigmoid (1-D unpenalized logistic of y on logit(p)) fit on the calibration sub-block ONLY - the 60 calendar days bearing PAs [cal_first..cal_last] per fold, derived at runtime (cal_last = max game_date <= train_end; cal_first = cal_last - 59 days). RAW and CAL lanes BOTH output, BOTH labeled (pred_raw / pred_cal), BOTH reported.

frozen_feature_construction_constants.note: inherited from the incumbent feature build (features_v3); not refit or retuned by this run

config.fold_calibration_rule: cal_last = max game_date <= train_end; cal_first = cal_last - 59 days (60 PA-bearing calendar days); derived at runtime

evaluation.bootstrap: paired slate-date bootstrap, block-stratified, row-weighted num/den ratio; ONE draw stream shared across candidates
evaluation.pooled_dev_note: dev blocks pooled only; confirm_2025H2 executed LAST and never pooled into dev

preflight.computed: 2026-10-15, read-only parquet reads (no fit, no score, no outputs written)
preflight.exclusion_interpretation: every excluded PA-table row is a 2022 warm-up row outside the 2023-01-01..2025-12-31 eligibility window; zero exclusions inside any fold window
preflight.availability_guard: passed on the full canonical frame: all src_date_* non-null and strictly < game_date; all src_type_* non-null
preflight.shared_rows_labels_verification: features identity is a subset of pa_table identity (anti-join = 0), so the loader's inner join drops 0 rows (loader fails loud otherwise, comparison.py:166-170). All candidates score the SAME eval rows: the runner asserts the per-fold eval identity hash is identical across candidates (comparison.py:743-744) and records it per candidate in the manifest; pinned by test_eval_identity_hash_matches_across_candidates. Labels: one loaded frame supplies y to every candidate; each preds parquet re-records y and the fold eval identity sha256.
preflight.preserved_2025_exposure_history: EW-90d rolling state (ew_pitcher/ew_batter) carries its own src_date_ew_* strictly prior to game_date (guard passed over all 549,296 rows), so 2025 assessment rows retain full prior exposure history through each game date. 2025 blocks already inspected (read-only, before this packet): (1) the executed assessment key sets keys_executed_block_2025H1.parquet and keys_executed_confirm_2025H2.parquet verified bit-identical to harness fold construction (CANDIDATE_MAP 'Executed bit-identity check', 2026-10-15); (2) canonical features_v3.parquet direct read, 549,296 x 54, ew_* present (HANDOFF_CAPABILITIES.md section 2); (3) this packet's preflight re-derived all four fold partitions + eval identity hashes read-only (2026-10-15). No 2026 rows exist in either input frame (2026 CLOSED).

config.output_write_once_note: write-once: run_comparison refuses to overwrite an existing output dir (WriteOnceError). The harness creates <output_destination>\<64-hex harness run_id>\ and records this packet's run_id as run_label.
